entry.author: Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment
entry.summary:
The Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment, Simon Upton, and staff present his review of New Zealand’s Land Use Capability (LUC) system to the New Zealand Parliament's Environment Committee,12 February 2026
Read the report here: https://pce.parliament.nz/publications/reviewing-the-use-of-the-luc-system-in-a-regulatory-context/
